intervals.label: SPICE/HeRALD R&D; proposed for LSM as a TESSERACT module
intervals.note: Earliest dated paper read carrying the combined collaboration tag; the proposal to host SPICE at LSM dates from 2022 (Nucl. Phys. B 2024). SPICE itself has no separately dated founding in the sources read.

intervals.label: planned installation of the TESSERACT setups (including SPICE) at LSM
intervals.quote: The two setups will be in LSM between 2027 and 2028

placements.note: Proposed placement: the SPICE module of the TESSERACT payload at LSM.
placements.quote: Combined with the US-based SPICE and HeRALD technologies, the TESSERACT at LSM experiment will then allow to probe DM candidates over 12 orders of magnitude in mass

summary.plain: Small crystals of sapphire, quartz or gallium arsenide, each carrying superconducting sensors on one face that register vibrations caused by a dark matter interaction.
summary.technical: 1 cm^3 Al2O3 and SiO2 crystals and GaAs cubes instrumented on one face with TES athermal-phonon sensors (two independent arrays per pixel); GaAs also read out through an optical cavity with an instrumented Ge photon collector.

technology.quote: SPICE aims at developing an array of 1 cm3 Al2O3 and SiO2 detectors, instrumented on one face with athermal phonon sensors
technology.value: Polar and scintillating crystals read out by TES athermal-phonon sensors
